Speculation Rises Over Potential Union Cabinet Reshuffle

Reports indicate a potential reshuffle of the Union Cabinet, with discussions focusing on increased representation for Madhya Pradesh. Several prominent BJP leaders from the state are reportedly being summoned to Delhi, suggesting possible changes in ministerial positions and political dynamics.
